source.scope: Published employer names having at least 15 positive compensation records in each name's latest available reporting period. Records are not necessarily unique employees.
source.captureMethod: Web search service extracted page text, completed by overlapping line ranges.
source.captureNote: Normalized observed directory rows are retained in this file. The extracted-text fingerprint identifies the research retrieval, not original HTML bytes; the transient extraction is not a committed source document.

datasetSummary.coverageDescription: Historical snapshot; employer coverage varies and newer releases are not yet included.

cautions: Published employer-name entries include aliases and historical names; do not treat 158 as a canonical employer count.
Period labels are preserved verbatim; exact reporting-period start and end dates are not established by this directory.
Compensation is the site's term; equivalence with salary or remuneration has not been established.
Directory excludes published names with fewer than 15 positive compensation records and displays only each published name's latest available period.
Unknown employer URLs use the observed directory URL and are marked urlScope:directory.
